hooks.name: core-determinism
hooks.description: Any agent edit in packages/core: fail loudly on Date.now, performance.now, Math.random, timers or browser globals (fusion-rules.md 1-2).

hooks.name: core-fast-properties
hooks.description: Save in the core or testkit: run the fusion property tests with 50 cases each (about 5 s).

hooks.name: lexicon-lint
hooks.description: Change in a lexicon pack or an app definition: lint every language for missing verbs/nouns and collisions, then run the parser and app tests.

action.command: npm run lexicon:lint && npx vitest run tests/unit/parser.test.ts tests/unit/apps.test.ts

hooks.name: new-replay-regression
hooks.description: A new replay file appears: run the replay regression suite so it becomes a permanent test.
